messages:
Priya Rao: heads-up, dependabot flagged multiple python CVEs affecting our stacks: CVE-2025-2048 (fastapi/starlette header parsing) and CVE-2025-3110 (tokenizers unsafe deserialization). links: https://security.example.com/CVE-2025-2048 and https://security.example.com/CVE-2025-3110 :eyes:
David Kim: thanks. which services are likely exposed? hosted-api, runtime, model-upload? any known exploit PoC?
Priya Rao: tokenizers one = deserialization during tokenizer loading from saved files (pickle/unsafe). Affects any service that loads user-provided tokenizers or community-model artifacts (inference runners, model registry import). fastapi/starlette is header parsing edge-case that could lead to request smuggling/unauth bypass on specific proxies. there's no public PoC yet but severity for tokenizers = high, fastapi = medium-high.
Sanjay Patel: agree with severity. tokenizers -> high priority to patch. fastapi/starlette -> patch but can add mitigations (WAF rules, stricter header validation) while we test.
David Kim: ok. I'll try a fast hotfix bump. previous attempt to update fastapi/starlette bumped starlette to a new minor that broke some middleware (routing signature changed). CI will tell.
CI Bot: workflow/run-tests on branch security/tokenizers-fastapi-fix started.
CI Bot: failing test sample:
```
FAILED tests/test_middleware.py::test_auth_middleware - TypeError: __init__() got an unexpected keyword argument 'scope_cls'
```
David Kim: yep that matches the starlette incompat. Plan: create two PRs -> (A) minimal tokenizers pin/update only, run tests; (B) fastapi bump + middleware compatibility fixes in separate PR. A should be low-risk and merge ASAP.
Priya Rao: +1. For tokenizers PR, we should also add a short runtime mitigation in the PR description: disable loading pickled tokenizers from untrusted paths and add an audit log event when tokenizer.from_pretrained is called for non-official models.
Sanjay Patel: also add a constraint file to pin starlette to the compat version in the hotfix to avoid accidental transitive bumps. e.g., constraints.txt with starlette==0.26.3 (example). After hotfix we can work on upgrading and refactoring.
David Kim: copying commands I'm running locally:
```
# update just tokenizers and lock
poetry add tokenizers@^0.14.2 --lock
poetry install
# run unit tests
pytest -q
```
I'll push PR A in ~30m.
Priya Rao: please tag security review and include CVE IDs and impact scope. I'll draft the advisory blurb for internal channel and prepare customer-facing language if we need to notify enterprise tenants.
David Kim: PR A opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/4123 . summary: bump tokenizers to 0.14.2, add audit log when tokenizer.from_pretrained called on non-official sources, add unit test to ensure blocked unsafe pickle loads. CI kicked off.
CI Bot: workflow/run-tests for PR 4123 succeeded (all unit tests passed).
Sanjay Patel: scanning changelog for tokenizers, looks like CVE fix is included. I'll sign off after a quick code read. Also creating a tracking ticket: INFSEC-2197 (patch rollout + post-release monitoring).
Ops Bot: deploy/hotfix pipeline queued for platform-hotfix-2026.
David Kim: note for PR B (fastapi/starlette) -> will target next maintenance window. There's non-trivial middleware and router changes; want to avoid rush breaking prod. I'll include migration notes and smoke tests.
Priya Rao: good. can we also ensure audit logs for model uploads and a KMS-based validation check on artifact integrity before loading? if not available now, add as backlog item with spike.
Sanjay Patel: opened INFSEC-2198 for KMS/artifact-integrity spike. we should also enable additional WAF rule to normalize headers at edge to mitigate CVE-2025-2048 until starlette patch lands.
David Kim: acknowledged. timeline: PR A merged and hotfixed within 2 hours. PR B follow-up during maintenance next week. I'll post updates here as things land.
Priya Rao: thanks all. I'll publish an internal advisory and notify customer success for any sensitive enterprise tenants. :thumbsup:
CI Bot: platform-hotfix-2026 deploy succeeded to canary. all good.
